name: serum response factor

function.text: SRF encodes serum response factor. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of miRNA transcription and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.
